name: EWARA Smoothness Expert Hair Conditioner
description: Tired of dull, frizzy, and unmanageable hair? EWARA Smoothness Expert Conditioner is formulated with Argan Oil, Aloe Vera, Bhringraj, Shea Butter and Panthenol to deeply nourish every strand. It helps tame flyaways, moisturize dry ends, improve shine and leave hair soft, smooth and easy to manage. Suitable for natural, chemically treated and color-treated hair. Apply after shampooing on damp hair from mid-lengths to ends, leave for 2–3 minutes and rinse thoroughly.
shortDescription: Argan Oil, Aloe Vera & Bhringraj conditioner for frizz-free, silky and shiny hair.

name: EWARA Onion Shampoo for Hair Fall Control
description: EWARA Onion Shampoo is a hair fall control shampoo made with Onion Extract, Bhringraj, Curry Leaves and Lavender. It gently cleanses the scalp while supporting stronger roots, reducing breakage and promoting healthy-looking hair growth. The formula removes dirt and excess oil without stripping natural moisture, leaving hair shiny, bouncy and fresh. Suitable for men and women with dry, oily, normal or color-treated hair.
shortDescription: Onion, Bhringraj & Curry Leaves shampoo for stronger roots and healthy growth.

name: EWARA Rice Water Hair Growth Shampoo
description: EWARA Rice Water Hair Growth Shampoo combines Rice Water, Amla and Aloe Vera to help strengthen weak strands, reduce breakage and support longer, thicker-looking hair. The Damage Defender formula helps repair brittle hair, moisturize the scalp and add natural volume and shine. Use 2–3 times a week and follow with EWARA Smoothness Expert Conditioner for best results.
shortDescription: Rice Water, Amla & Aloe Vera shampoo for long, strong and thick hair.

name: EWARA Ubtan Glow Facewash
description: EWARA Ubtan Glow Facewash brings traditional Ubtan care into a daily face wash. Infused with Turmeric, Saffron and Sandalwood Extract, it helps brighten the skin, remove tan, gently exfoliate dead skin cells and deep cleanse oil, dirt and pollution. Suitable for all skin types and ideal for both men and women who want fresh, radiant and confident-looking skin.
shortDescription: Turmeric and Saffron facewash for de-tan, skin brightening and radiant glow.

name: EWARA Activated Charcoal Facewash
description: EWARA Activated Charcoal Facewash is designed for deep detox, oil control and pollution defense. Activated Charcoal helps draw out impurities and unclog pores, while the pH-balanced, paraben-free and sulphate-free formula cleanses without making skin feel tight or dry. Best suited for oily and combination skin but gentle enough for all skin types.
shortDescription: Activated Charcoal facewash for deep detox, pollution defense and oil control.

name: EWARA Anti-Bacterial Tea Tree Facewash
description: EWARA Anti-Bacterial Tea Tree Facewash is formulated with Tea Tree Oil, Neem Extracts and Aloe Vera to help fight acne-causing bacteria, control excess oil and keep skin fresh. It deep cleans pores, removes dirt and pollution, supports a matte finish and helps reduce pimples and dullness. The formula is paraben-free, sulphate-free and soap-free for daily use.
shortDescription: Tea Tree, Neem and Aloe Vera facewash for acne, pimples and oil control.

name: EWARA Wild Lust Solid Perfume
description: EWARA Wild Lust Solid Perfume is an alcohol-free 10g balm perfume made for bold, intense and long-lasting fragrance. The wax-based formula stays close to pulse points and slowly releases scent through body heat. It is pocket-friendly, travel-safe, discreet and suitable for men and women. Apply on wrists, neck and behind the ears for a confident fragrance touch-up anytime.
shortDescription: Alcohol-free 10g solid perfume with bold, intense and long-lasting fragrance.

name: EWARA Moon Kiss Solid Perfume
description: EWARA Moon Kiss Solid Perfume is a soft, romantic and elegant alcohol-free fragrance balm in a 10g travel-friendly tin. The solid formula glides smoothly, stays close to the skin and slowly releases scent through body heat. It is paraben-free, leak-proof and ideal for office wear, gifting, evenings and quick fragrance touch-ups on the go.
shortDescription: Alcohol-free 10g solid perfume with soft, romantic and elegant fragrance.

name: EWARA Honey & Almond Bliss Body Lotion - 500ml
description: Indulge your skin in rich nourishment with EWARA Honey & Almond Bliss Body Lotion. Powered with the goodness of honey, almond oil, and Vitamin E, this lotion deeply moisturizes, leaving your skin soft, smooth, and naturally radiant. Honey helps lock in moisture and keeps skin hydrated, almond oil nourishes deeply and improves softness, and Vitamin E supports healthy-looking glowing skin. The lightweight, fast-absorbing, non-sticky formula provides long-lasting hydration, making it comfortable for daily use across all skin types. Apply generously on clean skin and massage gently until absorbed. Best used after bath for long-lasting hydration.
shortDescription: Honey, almond oil and Vitamin E body lotion for soft, nourished and hydrated skin.

name: EWARA Fruit Bliss Body Lotion - Mix Fruit Extracts | 500ml
description: Pamper your skin daily with EWARA Fruit Bliss Body Lotion, a nourishing blend of fruit extracts and Vitamin E designed to keep your skin hydrated, soft, and naturally glowing. The fruit-powered formula supports healthy-looking skin, helps lock in moisture, and leaves a refreshing fruity fragrance. Its lightweight, fast-absorbing texture avoids sticky or oily residue while helping maintain a smooth, supple, and radiant feel. Suitable for daily skincare routines and all skin types. Apply evenly on clean skin and massage gently until fully absorbed. Use daily for best results.
shortDescription: Mixed fruit extracts and Vitamin E body lotion for soft, glowing and hydrated skin.
